edges.notes: LTO and codegen outputs feed lld in LLVM-based builds.
lld consumes and emits ELF objects/executables on typical Unix-class targets.
Substitutable with GNU ld in many ELF link workflows (clang -fuse-ld=lld, rustc defaults).
Clang commonly invokes lld when configured as the system or project linker.
Clang driver selects lld when configured (e.g. -fuse-ld=lld).
wasm-ld links wasi-libc objects into Wasm modules for WASI targets.
rustc uses lld by default on many platforms (rustc platform documentation).
Some kernel/toolchain configurations use LLVM=1 / lld paths; not universal.
LLVM/lld supports RISC-V among many targets.
lld resolves libc++ (and libc++abi) symbols when linking Clang -stdlib=libc++ outputs.
lld resolves libc++abi when finalizing libc++-using binaries on LLVM toolchains.
